run_parallel_compile_patch: run monkeypatch_compile_maybe to enable parallel C/C++ compilation during gRPC Python extension builds
review_parallel_compile: review the _parallel_compile function that uses ThreadPool to compile C/C++ source files in parallel
build_grpc_python_extension: build a gRPC Python extension with GRPC_PYTHON_BUILD_EXT_COMPILER_JOBS set to enable parallel compilation
refactor_compile_jobs: refactor the BUILD_EXT_COMPILER_JOBS environment variable parsing to support additional fallback logic
test_monkeypatch_compile: test monkeypatch_compile_maybe to verify CCompiler.compile is patched when jobs are greater than one
